en: Sepia-toned image showing a stone-vaulted underground or basement space, likely part of an old fortification or castle. The room has rough masonry walls and an arched stone ceiling. In the center is a small stone bridge spanning a lower pit or channel filled with rubble. At the far side are arched doorways with metal bars, suggesting dungeon cells or storage rooms. On the right side stands a simple wooden walkway or railing structure, perhaps added later for visitors. The border and wear of the card suggest an early 20th‑century printed postcard. No visible text appears on the image side.
